market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $40,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~$76,500; 2026 low ~$60K. $40K would require another ~33% drop from the recent low or ~48% from spot in 8 months — consistent with a deep bear-cycle low rather than a typical correction. Historical drawdowns of this size after an already 39% decline are uncommon but possible. Market 0.205 is roughly fair; my estimate slightly lower.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Severity of any 2026 macro recession or financial shock
